Block vs inline elements
Block boxes normally start a new line; inline boxes flow within text. CSS display can change
Block element සාමාන්‍යJයන් අලුත් line එකක පටන් ගන්නවා. Inline element එක text එකේක
Paragraphs form separate rows; a highlighted word remains within a sentence.
1 Block: paragraph 1 · 2 Block: paragraph 2 · 3 Inline: text + strong + text
Read the numbered stages from top to bottom. Block: paragraph 1; Inline: text + strong + text.
Expected result: Two paragraphs; important is bold within the second.
Interview question: Can CSS make an inline element block-level?
Answer: Yes, display: block changes its box layout, not its HTML meaning.
Practice: Apply display:block to a span and compare the layout.
